Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a program for offender education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to offender education; adding new sections tochapter 72.09 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to create a programin civic education to be taught in conjunction with basic skillseducation. This program is designed to facilitate successfulreintegration into the community following release.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) As a component of basic skills education, the department shallcreate, by rule, a program to provide offenders who are United Statescitizens with the opportunity to participate in programs designed toeducate offenders on American citizenship and civil rights. Theprogram shall include, but not be limited to, the following topics: (a) Responsible citizenship; (b) Rights lost to felony offenders and restoration, including gunownership and possession; (c) Voting laws and felony voting rights restoration; p. 1 SSB 6406 (d) Legal financial obligations; (e) Sex offender registration and community notification; and (f) Civic participation, including participation in local, state,and federal government processes, school boards, neighborhoodorganizations, and nonprofit or volunteer organizations. (2) Upon satisfactory completion of a program, the department shallissue a certificate of completion to an offender.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall provide to offenders, before release into thecommunity, information regarding community service providers thatprovide educational services and other assistance programs tooffenders.
